# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** 10  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Yankee  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) (relative), [Irving](../character/irving.md) (parent)

## Appearance

Paul Irving is distinguished by features of exquisite delicacy and refinement, framed by a halo of naturally curly chestnut hair, which is also described as brown. He has very dark blue eyes that watch others intently.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029)_

## Personality

Paul Irving is an imaginative and exceptionally talented child, described by others as both a darling and a genius who shares the rare trait of having "dream-people." Naturally clean, manly, and polite, he is regarded as a perfect little gentleman who holds his own in games. He also demonstrates a protective, helpful nature toward younger students at school, shielding them from older boys and teaching them games.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), +1 more_

## History

Paul Irving came from the [States](../codex/places.md#states) to live with his grandmother three years after his mother passed away. Upon attending school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he quickly became a bright, imaginative student and the favorite pupil of his teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). He brightened Anne's first day of teaching by gifting her wild orchids, and he later wrote her a letter detailing his magical imaginary friends at the shore. At the end of the school year, Paul walked with [Anne](../character/anne.md) to the cemetery, where they discussed their loved ones and placing flowers on graves. [Anne](../character/anne.md) later visited Paul for tea to reassure him about his imaginative thoughts after a maid had called him strange. During a visit with [Anne](../character/anne.md) to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Paul enjoyed playing with the echoes, coping with his grandmother's strict rules, and connecting with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) over her stories of an imaginary dream-boy. After Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), reunited with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Paul discussed the romantic turn of events and their upcoming wedding with [Anne](../character/anne.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), +401 more_

## Quotes

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--paul-irving.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Paul's schoolteacher and close friend. Their bond began on her first day of teaching when Paul gave her wild orchids, quickly becoming her favorite pupil due to his bright, imaginative mind. They share a deep connection through writing letters, discussing loved ones, and sharing imaginative stories.

- Friend of — teacher and student friendship  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P1](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0001), +2 more</sub>
- Student of — schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), +3 more</sub>

### [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--paul-irving.md)

[Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) is Paul's grandmother who raises him and sets strict rules for his upbringing. Despite her rigid discipline, Paul respects her and talks about her during his outings. Their household dynamic is a frequent topic of conversation when Paul discusses his daily life and imagination with others.

- Relative of — grandmother  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), +4 more</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--paul-irving.md)

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) is Paul's father. Paul experiences a major change in his home life when his father reconnects with and prepares to marry Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), a romantic event that Paul discusses with [Anne](../character/anne.md) during the wedding preparations.

- Child of — father  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is a friend and kindred spirit to Paul. They connect deeply through their shared love of fantasy, spending time sitting together in her garden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) sharing stories about imaginary people.

- Friend of — kindred spirits sharing stories and imagination in the garden  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)</sub>

### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--paul-irving.md)

[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community member who takes a fond interest in Paul. She often discusses his unique personality and imaginative nature with other townspeople.

- Friend of — fond of the young boy  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

### [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--twin-sailors.md)

The [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) are imaginary rock figures created by Paul along the shore. Paul writes about them as pretend friends who come ashore to talk with him and go on fantastical ocean adventures, though he explicitly clarifies that they are not real.

- presumed Friend of — imaginary rock people who come ashore to talk with him  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
